claims.text: Ad ROI Calculator is a free tool published at blackarrow.ltd/tools, no signup required
Calculator uses the visitor's own inputs run through fixed model assumptions to produce illustrative estimates, not guaranteed benchmarks
Requests for done-for-you work are reviewed personally with a response within one business day.
The first meeting diagnoses the pipeline (lead intake, response speed, where leads stall) before any pricing is discussed.
Scope and pricing for done-for-you services are only discussed after that diagnosis meeting.
